subject: BUG-074: ModuleProgress.completeQuiz() throws on the first quiz notification -- showCompletionNotification is called at ModuleProgress.js:1187 but defined nowhere. Score and Firestore sync survive (they precede the throw at :763) but the activity-feed event and return-to-hub navigation are skipped. Pre-existing, dated to be2a4cbb8. Fix: extract style injection out of showCompletionOverlay, call from both; drop the stale .module-complete-notification selector.
description: Also: callers pass {showNotification:true} but completeQuiz destructures {silent,...} -- showNotification is not a real option and is silently ignored, so callers cannot suppress this path.
